WHAT REPRODUCED AND WHAT DID NOT. Seven of the nine mnemonic-divergence counts and seven of the nine word counts reproduce the census EXACTLY, which is worth saying plainly: the census's numbers are NOT stale by construction at one day's age, and the standing 'remeasure before quoting' rule survived its own test here rather than catching an error. TWO WORD COUNTS DID NOT REPRODUCE, both upward: AudioWithName 24 -> 37 and fn_80093918 33 -> 38. Both misses share one cause, and it is the reason the FRAME column belongs in any schedule-class table: neither function is purely schedule-class. AudioWithName carries a 16-byte frame delta (`@0x14 stwu r1,-56(r1)` in the target against `@0xc stwu r1,-72(r1)` in ours) and fn_80093918 carries an 8-byte one (`@0x8 stwu r1,-112(r1)` / `@0x14 stmw r25,60(r1)` against ours `@0x8 stwu r1,-120(r1)` / `@0x14 stmw r25,68(r1)`). A frame-size difference is STACK_LAYOUT, categorically outside the schedule class, and it is invisible to both the mnemonic-divergence count and the opcode multiset - `rc_recolor_class.py` classifies both functions as SCHEDULE-REORDER while the surplus locals sit there. RANKING CONSEQUENCE: rank a schedule-class queue on mnemonic divergences AND a frame check, or two of every nine rows will be stack work wearing a schedule label.

WHAT THIS LANE DID WITH THE TABLE. MBCameraUpdate: worked to real 60 -> 34, fuzzy 95.2767 -> 99.1698, words 36 -> 18, and RECLASSIFIED from SCHEDULE-REORDER (6 mnemonic divergences) to LIVE-RANGE-RECOLOR (0) with an exact callee-saved identity map - see attempt.CT_mbcameraupdate-statement-order-drive.20260903.v1. print_n_of_m: real 32 -> 22, fuzzy 95.7353 -> 96.2500, words 20 -> 15, five-register permutation reduced to one transposed pair - see attempt.CT_print-n-of-m-param-copy-local-numbering.20260903.v1. setTexInfo: three lever classes, nothing retained - see attempt.CT_settexinfo-prologue-hoist-and-loaded-web.20260903.v1. ScreenSaver: NOT WORKED, and this is a deliberate VETO rather than an omission - attempt.SC_screensaver-preheader-schedule.20260901.v1 reduced it to one named mechanism (the target splits an HA/LO address pair around an unrelated store in a 4-instruction loop preheader) across three axes that each left the cluster BIT-IDENTICAL, and its own conclusion is that the split is not expressible in C. fn_80093918: NOT WORKED past measurement - attempt.fn80093918-preoffset-association-memberform.20260831.v1 states DO-NOT-RETRY on the association axis after nine forms across three functions and three sessions, and its residual prose does not mention the 8-byte frame delta measured here, which is the one genuinely open axis left on that function.

REPRODUCE: `python tools/gdl/composed_census/rc_recolor_class.py --batch <rows.json>` for the divergence counts and classifications, `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_word_diff.py <unit> <fn>` per row for the words, `python tools/gdl/fnasm.py <unit> <fn> 0x0:0x30 --diff` per row for the frame column, and the `units` key of config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json for the pin column. All four are zero-build against current objects.
